comments:
This appears to correspond to the 72-folio manuscript with the signature phyi tsa 102 listed in [HMSTSJ7Q]: 74, No. 30.11 (spyod 'jug gi rnam gzhag snar thang sangs rgyas yon tan dpal bzang; 72 fols.)
The signature "phyi tsa 102" is reported in [6TNNKSQ3]: 65, but is not visible on the image in [KUYBGM7V]. [6TNNKSQ3] also reports that the manuscript is kept at Zhwa lu monastery.
